data.name: Farnad
data.gender_notes: Farnad is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Persian word 'Far', meaning excellent or noble. The name Farnad carries the meaning “Excellent, Noble” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Persian. Parents who choose Farnad usually hope their child will grow to embody excellent, noble and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Signifies a person who is noble, just, and kind.
data.etymology: Farnad belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Excellent, Noble.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Farnad total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_arabic.name: فرناد
in_arabic.meaning: فرناد اسم العلم يعني الشخص الحكيم والمتعلم
in_arabic.long_meaning: فرناد هو اسم علم مشتق من الجذر اللغوي فارنادي، ويعني الشخص الحكيم والمتعلم والذكي، وقد ورد في بعض التفاسير أنه يعني الشخص الذي يمتلك الحكمة والفهم العميق للنصوص الدينية والعالم

in_urdu.name: فرنڈ
in_urdu.meaning: فرنڈ نام کا مطلب عقلمند اور تعلیم یافتہ شخص
in_urdu.long_meaning: فرنڈ ایک علم کا نام ہے جو عربی زبان کے جذر فارنادي سے ماخوذ ہے، اور اس کا مطلب ہے عقلمند، تعلیم یافتہ، اور ذہین شخص۔ اردو میں، اس نام کو ان لوگوں کے لیے استعمال کیا جاتا ہے جو دین و دنیا میں حکیمانہ سوچ بچارے ہیں

in_hindi.name: फरनाड
in_hindi.meaning: फरनाड नाम का अर्थ बुद्धिमान और विद्वान व्यक्ति
in_hindi.long_meaning: फरनाड एक नाम है जो अरबी भाषा के जड़ فارنادي से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है बुद्धिमान, विद्वान और चतुर व्यक्ति। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, यह नाम उन लोगों के लिए प्रयोग किया जाता है जो धार्मिक और सांसारिक मामलों में बुद्धिमत्ता और गहराई से सोचते हैं

in_pashto.name: فرناد
in_pashto.meaning: فرناد نوم دى چاڼ هېواد يو زده کړی او هوښیار سړی
in_pashto.long_meaning: فرناد د يو نوم ډول دى چاڼ د عربي ژبې د جذر فارنادي څخه اخستى شوى، او دى د زده کړي، هوښيار او دانا سړي په معنا. په پښتنو ټولنو کې، دا نوم د هغو کسانو لپاره کارول کېږي چا ته د دين او د نړۍ په چارو کې حکمت او پوهه لري

in_english.name: Farnad
in_english.meaning: Farnad means wise, learned, and intelligent person

Historically, this name has been used in Islamic tradition to signify individuals with profound understanding and insight into religious and worldly matters

In Islamic tradition, light is often used as a metaphor for knowledge and wisdom, which are essential virtues for the spiritual growth and self-improvement of Muslims. Therefore, the name Farnad can be seen as a constant reminder to strive towards knowledge, wisdom, and spiritual enlightenment throughout one's life. It is also a reminder to be a source of light and guidance for others, making Farnad an inspiring and meaningful name for those seeking a deeper connection with their spiritual side.

historical_references.context: Ibn Battuta describes a stop at a place called al-Farnad, which is likely to be present-day Faranah in Morocco.

historical_references.reference: Ibn Khaldun's The Muqaddimah, Book 1, Chapter 2: 'The Bedouins and the Sedentary Arabs: The Rise of the Dynasties of the Berbers and the Spread of Islam in the Maghrib'
historical_references.context: Ibn Khaldun mentions the city of al-Farnad, which was one of the major cities of the Maghrib, ruled by the Marinid dynasty during his time.
